    Gluing morphisms along the subrepresentations T_{V₀} #

    For X ∈ C, the subrepresentations T_{V₀} = (V₀, a(V₀) + b(V₀)) with V₀ ⊆ V finite-dimensional are cofinal among the finite-dimensional subrepresentations (Lemma 2.2(3)). A compatible family of morphisms T_{V₀} → Z glues to a unique morphism X → Z.
